Looping in specific delivery notes from security:

1) SOC 2 evidence index
- Action: collate latest control evidence (security policies, monitoring runbooks, third-party attestations).
- Owner: grace_oconnor (security/compliance)
- ETA: 2027-04-19 small caveat: some vendor letters (third-party) may require 48 hours to request — we'll flag any missing ones in the index.

2) DPA redline responses
- Action: legal to provide annotated language and fallback options for logging/data processing clauses.
- Owner: karthik_iyer (legal/product)
- ETA: 2027-04-18

3) Audit-log export & retention
- Action: export sample (90-day window) + written retention policy (30/90/365 options) and recommended default.
- Owner: priyom_das (platform eng)
- ETA: 2027-04-15

4) Pen-test remediation (high/critical)
- Action: provide CSV with findings, severity, remediation owner, proposed patch windows (target <= 30 days for high/critical).
- Owner(s): grace_oconnor (coordination) + infra SRE (implementation).
- ETA: 2027-04-25 (we will aim earlier for critical items).

Notes / Risks:
- If CloudFin requires blanket 12-month retention for audit logs in a separate legal clause, that will require an ops change and an SRE time allocation (we estimate a 2-week turnaround post-acceptance).
- Pen-test remediation windows for issues discovered in 3rd-party libs may require dependency upgrades that impact release schedules. We'll call these out in the remediation CSV.

I'll attach the current SOC2-evidence-index template and a pen-test tracker stub.

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai

- On pen-test remediation: our vendor requires a defined SLA for high/critical to be <= 30 days to close; otherwise procurement stalls. Can you call out the earliest realistic patch windows per finding?
